senses.definition: An acute febrile illness of tropical regions, caused by a flavivirus (Yellow fever virus) and spread by certain mosquitoes, characterised by jaundice, black vomit and the absence of urination.
senses.example: The town up the road was overcome by yellow fever, he said. All travelers warned away.

senses.definition: An attraction to ethnically East Asian men or women, expressed by non-East Asian (especially white European male or white American) people.
senses.example: Your girl want me, we both know / Cause she got yellow fever

senses.definition: A lust for gold; an obsession with seeking gold ore.
senses.example: He's got the yellow fever; Once get the sight of gold and you are poisoned.
